summary: IDS feed s084_single is degraded due to VXLAN encapsulation: 23.1% of frames (580/2506) arrive inside VXLAN tunnel (VNI 580) and cannot be inspected by the IDS. All other checks (duplicates, encrypted share, VLANs, one-way, oversize, drops, overload, truncation) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker is forwarding VXLAN-encapsulated traffic (VNI 580) directly to the IDS without decapsulation. IDS sees only outer VXLAN/UDP/IP headers and cannot parse inner Ethernet/IP payload for signatures.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to inner payload on ~23% of traffic; signature matching and anomaly detection fail on encapsulated flows, reducing detection coverage and causing missed alerts despite needing full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Stripping VXLAN header on the packet broker exposes inner L2-L7 headers/payload so the IDS can inspect traffic natively without tunnel-aware decoding.
